URGENT - our MD is personally following up on this and the consignment is held until it is done. Please do this TODAY, no delays, we have been a loyal partner for years.

Dear Accounts Team,

Please find below our tax invoice for the October consignment of finished leather (PO-7781).

Tax Invoice No: INV/2026-27/0045
Date: 20-11-2026
Supplier: Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 09AAACA1234A1ZI
Amount payable: Rs 1,18,000.00 (incl. GST)
Please remit to our account on file with you.

Many thanks in advance - your accounts team is honestly the best we work with, and we always recommend you to others.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Accounts Manager, Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd
